verdict.rationale: Graphite ships some rule/event-driven automation: AI review auto-triggers on new PRs with no configuration (docs-19, docs-18), custom rules constrain when the review agent comments (docs-5, docs-20, docs-28), and a named 'Automations' feature appears in pricing (docs-33) alongside webhook-driven CI/merge event handling (docs-24) and stack-aware merge queue automation (docs-10). However, there is no dedicated documentation describing a general-purpose rules engine where a user defines arbitrary event→action triggers beyond PR-review and merge behaviors. Missing for 10: dedicated docs for the 'Automations' feature explaining supported trigger events/actions, evidence of custom/arbitrary action definitions beyond review-comment suppression, and independent confirmation of automation reliability.
